title: Search finds products by name (broke)
contract: Every product price, line total, subtotal, discount and order total is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00
reason: Final verification failed: "every product price, line total, subtotal, discount and order total is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00"

verdict.title: Price-formatting check ran before cart totals were available
verdict.oneLiner: The check was run on a search-results page, where only product prices were visible and no line totals, subtotal, discount, or order total existed to verify.
verdict.rootCause: The run stopped after opening search results instead of moving to a cart or order page that shows all of the required money fields.
verdict.suggestion: Update the test flow to add an item and open the cart or checkout before checking line totals, subtotal, discounts, and the order total.

rejectedBecause: Not a product bug: Kane failed the search page on a price rule that listed subtotals and totals, which a search page doesn't have. The rule was worded too broadly; Gremlin now tells Kane a rule holds when nothing on the page falls under it.
